turn_history.speaker: student
turn_history.text: I have: This graph shows how far Fido the dog is from his home. I got Fido has fallen asleep because I'm not sure I worked it out the right way.

turn_history.text: Oh right, so if the line is going down, that means the distance is getting smaller... so Fido must be getting closer to home? But I'm still a bit confused about why it would go down instead of staying flat if he's moving - wouldn't moving away make it go up?
